redFirst.basis: regression mode, expectRedFirst false. Red was observed before the fix by calling tools/sweep-selftests.py run_one with encoding=cp1252 on the one file: exit 1, FAIL ur9 and ur10, 522/524. Green under utf-8 (524/524).

outcome.technical: Cause was in the test's own subprocess setup, not run-test-gate.py. The fixture gate script emit.py did print('\u2713 ...'); the gate child inherits PYTHONIOENCODING=cp1252, so the print raised UnicodeEncodeError, the gate went red (exit 1) and no NO OVERLAP banner was produced. Fix in plugins/audit/tests/test_run_test_gate.py _unrecorded_cases: emit.py now writes utf-8 bytes via sys.stdout.buffer. After the fix, run_one with encoding=cp1252 gives code 0 and 524/524, and run_one without encoding gives code 0 and 524/524. run-test-gate.py unchanged. The full sweep and the other gate commands were not run.
outcome.descriptive: ur9/ur10 no longer depend on the locale code page: the fixture emits its tick as utf-8 bytes.
